en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street leading toward a town hall with a clock tower and belfry. In the foreground are traditional European houses and a tree-lined street. Visible shop and building signs include a hotel and a Ratskeller (town-hall cellar restaurant). The printed caption at the top in red German text reads "Ortrand. Blick nach dem Rathaus."
